sap.app.title: Toolbar vs Bar vs OverflowToolbar
sap.app.description: Side-by-side comparison of sap.m.Toolbar, sap.m.Bar, and sap.m.OverflowToolbar in equivalent configurations. Useful for choosing the right container: Toolbar for general content rows, Bar for page headers/footers, OverflowToolbar when items must overflow to a popover.
